'''Liiria Beldonna''' was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] leader of an organization of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]<ref name="SotePG" /> known as [[Beldonna's League]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> also referred to as "Beldonna's Legion."<ref name="SotePG" />

==Biography==
Liiria Beldonna was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]]<ref name="SotePG" /> woman born sometime around [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="Age" /> 

By roughly [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], she had built up an organization of hired mercenaries referred to as "Beldonna's League"<ref name="SWG" /> or "Beldonna's Legion."<ref name="SotePG" /> Elements of the group were stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG" /> Beldonna led the Legion under a strict set of rules and did not tolerate misconduct; her men were fiercely loyal to her.<ref name="SotePG" />

Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the group was hired by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Consul-General]] [[Gilad Halsek]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], who was infatuated with Beldonna, to help bolster the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] security. Beldonna enjoyed her position on Kothlis and frequently took her team hunting in the forest or the planet's [[Water/Legends|ice]] caps.<ref name="SotePG" />

One day, ten of her men went on a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] to relieve those guarding the [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150]] [[ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] hidden in a valley in the [[Ragnook Mountains]], as done every 40 [[Local day/Legends|days]]. Liria decided to come along for a surprise inspection. Right when they arrived, they witnessed that [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[agent/Legends|agents]], sneaked into the control bunker to steal some parts. Liria and her men tried to [[Stun/Legends|stun]] and capture the Rebels.<ref name="SotePG" /><ref>{{WEGCite|story=Ion Cannon Parts|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
As an adult, she was considered attractive and relatively frail-looking, but in actuality she had well-toned muscles and could handle herself well in a fight. She was a confident woman and an inspiring leader, and trained herself in the use of most weapons. Beldonna had long, straight black hair that she usually kept braided when she was working. She also enjoyed attracting attention by parading about the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tal'cara]] and going to its most popular nightspots.<ref name="SotePG" />
